title: The Courtyard Behind the Shops
paras: Welcome to the museum’s smallest city exhibition. This room tells the story of a courtyard behind six shops on Willow Street. In 1982, the shopkeepers turned this empty space into a shared garden. The blue path beneath your feet is made from broken plates: an early example of local [[recycling|recycling]].

Start with the photograph beside the door. The [[slim|slim]] woman holding a watering can is Mina Costa, who worked in a nearby [[laboratory|laboratory]]. She tested the garden soil before planting began. Under the apple tree lived a [[tortoise|tortoise]] called Button. Visitors can still rest in the tree’s [[shade|shade]] when the courtyard opens each summer.

Next, press the green button to hear Mina’s memories. One recording includes the sound of [[crying|crying]]. These were happy tears: Button had returned after disappearing for three weeks. He was found inside a neighbour’s open shed. His safe return seemed [[unbelievable|unbelievable]] to Mina, who had searched every evening.

The final display was created during one spring [[semester|semester]] by a college art class. Their model shows how the garden looks now. Small signs [[encourage|encourage]] visitors to grow flowers in their own streets. Please close the courtyard gate after your visit; [[otherwise|otherwise]], Button’s young relatives may escape. Beyond it, the busy shopping street seems a little less grey.
zh: 欢迎来到本馆规模最小的城市展览。这个展厅讲述了柳树街六家商店后面一座小院的故事。1982年，店主们把这片空地改造成了共享花园。您脚下的蓝色小路是用碎盘子铺成的，是当地早期回收利用的一个例子。
请先看门边的照片。那位身材苗条、手拿浇水壶的女士叫米娜·科斯塔，当时在附近的一间实验室工作。种植开始前，她检测了花园里的土壤。苹果树下曾住着一只名叫纽扣的陆龟。如今，每年夏天小院开放时，游客仍然可以在这棵树的阴凉处休息。
接下来，请按绿色按钮，听米娜讲述往事。其中一段录音里有哭声。那是喜悦的泪水：纽扣失踪三周后回来了。人们在邻居一间敞着门的小棚屋里找到了它。它能平安归来，让米娜觉得难以置信。此前，她每天晚上都出去寻找。
最后一个展区由一个大学美术班在某个春季学期制作完成。他们的模型展示了花园如今的模样。小标牌鼓励游客在自己居住的街道上种花。参观结束后，请关好院门，否则纽扣的小辈们可能会溜出去。走出院门，那条繁忙的商业街似乎也不再那么灰暗了。

q.s: The shopkeepers received money from the town council to create the garden.
q.why: 文章未说明改建花园是否获得市政资助。

q.s: Mina tested the soil before planting began.
q.why: 第二段明确说她在开始种植前检测了土壤。

q.s: The crying in the recording expressed sadness about Button's disappearance.
q.why: 第三段说明那是纽扣归来后的喜悦泪水。
